comportamentos: Add Unicode/math-capable fonts (NotoSansMath, DejaVu) to the PDF generator and extend the fallback font list so characters like sigma render in PDFs: missing
Store Unicode characters such as sigma in thesis titles without error: present via a different approach (MySQL utf8mb4 conversion), which the official fix does not use
justificativa: The official fix handles Unicode by adding math-capable fallback fonts to PDF generation, while the candidate only converts MySQL tables to utf8mb4 and leaves PDF rendering of characters like sigma unaddressed.
